summary.what_broke: Clients reject the TLS certificate of checkout.example.com because the certificate on the HTTPS listener of the load balancer checkout-prod expired at 12:00:00.
summary.impact: Clients that validate certificates cannot call the checkout API; the service, its targets and its database are healthy.
summary.scope: Only the HTTPS listener of checkout-prod in prod-main; the ECS tasks, the targets and the database are healthy.

symptoms: Clients report TLS certificate errors when calling checkout.example.com
The health monitor of checkout.example.com fails

causes.label: confirmed
causes.statement: The certificate 9a8b7c6d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d on the HTTPS listener of checkout-prod expired at 12:00:00, so clients reject the TLS handshake to checkout.example.com

causes.label: candidate
causes.statement: The deployment of checkout-api:41 at 10:05 broke the application

hypotheses.statement: The certificate served by the load balancer has expired
hypotheses.prediction: The certificate of the HTTPS listener is EXPIRED, with an expiry inside the incident window
hypotheses.test: Read the listener and its certificate in ACM

hypotheses.statement: The deployment of checkout-api:41 broke the application
hypotheses.prediction: Tasks or targets are unhealthy when the impact starts
hypotheses.test: Read the deployment, the task definition change and the target health

hypotheses.statement: A second certificate on the listener also expires soon
hypotheses.prediction: Another certificate of the listener has an expiry date in the next days
hypotheses.test: List the certificates of the listener

actions.label: recommended
actions.title: Replace the expired certificate on the HTTPS listener of checkout-prod
actions.current_state: Listener HTTPS 443 serves certificate 9a8b7c6d-1e2f-4a3b-8c4d-5e6f7a8b9c0d, which expired at 12:00:00
actions.required_state: The listener serves an ISSUED certificate for checkout.example.com that has not expired
actions.change: Request or import a valid certificate for checkout.example.com in ACM in eu-west-1, then set it as the default certificate of listener HTTPS 443 of checkout-prod
actions.rationale: The certificate is the one the listener serves, and it expired five seconds before the impact started
actions.risk: A wrong certificate would keep clients failing; the targets are not touched
preconditions: A valid certificate for checkout.example.com exists in ACM in eu-west-1
verification: A TLS handshake to checkout.example.com presents a certificate that has not expired
The health monitor of checkout.example.com passes
rollback: Set the previous certificate as the default certificate of the listener again

actions.label: candidate
actions.title: Renew the certificate of checkout.example.com automatically and alert before it expires
actions.current_state: The certificate expired without a renewal or an alert
actions.required_state: The certificate renews itself, and an alert fires 30 days before any expiry
actions.change: Use an ACM certificate with DNS validation that renews itself, and add an alarm on days to expiry for it
actions.risk: A DNS validation record must be kept in place
verification: The new certificate shows renewal eligibility ELIGIBLE or a renewal date
rollback: Remove the alarm; keep the old certificate until the new one is serving

open_questions: Why was the certificate not renewed before it expired?

not_checked.why: The service runs on ECS and no cluster is mapped

map_changes: Add the listener of the load balancer checkout-prod to the resources of the prod environment of checkout-api
